name: Edge-IIoTset
split: stratified random 70/15/15 by finest attack type (no usable time order)

dropped_columns.frame.time: timestamp/date: identifies capture session, not behaviour; also column-misaligned for all DDoS_UDP/MITM rows
dropped_columns.ip.src_host: IP address: host identifier, lets the model memorise testbed hosts
dropped_columns.ip.dst_host: IP address: host identifier, lets the model memorise testbed hosts
dropped_columns.arp.src.proto_ipv4: IP address: host identifier, lets the model memorise testbed hosts
dropped_columns.arp.dst.proto_ipv4: IP address: host identifier, lets the model memorise testbed hosts
dropped_columns.tcp.srcport: raw client/server port: replaced by derived service_port (the lower, server-side port)
dropped_columns.tcp.dstport: raw client/server port: replaced by derived service_port (the lower, server-side port)
dropped_columns.tcp.ack: per-packet sequence/ack/checksum/stream counter: identifier, not behaviour
dropped_columns.tcp.ack_raw: per-packet sequence/ack/checksum/stream counter: identifier, not behaviour
dropped_columns.tcp.seq: per-packet sequence/ack/checksum/stream counter: identifier, not behaviour
dropped_columns.tcp.checksum: per-packet sequence/ack/checksum/stream counter: identifier, not behaviour
dropped_columns.icmp.checksum: per-packet sequence/ack/checksum/stream counter: identifier, not behaviour
dropped_columns.icmp.seq_le: per-packet sequence/ack/checksum/stream counter: identifier, not behaviour
dropped_columns.icmp.transmit_timestamp: per-packet sequence/ack/checksum/stream counter: identifier, not behaviour
dropped_columns.udp.stream: per-packet sequence/ack/checksum/stream counter: identifier, not behaviour
dropped_columns.mbtcp.trans_id: per-packet sequence/ack/checksum/stream counter: identifier, not behaviour
dropped_columns.tcp.options: raw TCP options bytes: embed per-packet TCP timestamp values (counter)
dropped_columns.tcp.payload: raw string: replaced by length (+ injection-character count for URIs/queries) summaries
dropped_columns.http.file_data: raw string: replaced by length (+ injection-character count for URIs/queries) summaries
dropped_columns.http.request.full_uri: raw string: replaced by length (+ injection-character count for URIs/queries) summaries
dropped_columns.http.request.uri.query: raw string: replaced by length (+ injection-character count for URIs/queries) summaries
dropped_columns.mqtt.msg: raw string: replaced by length (+ injection-character count for URIs/queries) summaries
dropped_columns.dns.qry.name: raw string: replaced by length (+ injection-character count for URIs/queries) summaries
dropped_columns.dns.qry.name.len: header-misaligned in source (holds hostnames); its length is kept as len_dns_name

derived_doc.service_port: lower non-zero of the two port numbers (server/service side); client ephemeral port discarded
derived_doc.len_*: character length of the raw string (bytes for hex payloads); 0 when absent
derived_doc.inj_*: count of injection-typical characters ' " < > % ; and '..' in the URI/query
derived_doc.__txt_http: HTTP method + first 80 chars of URI: used ONLY in the text descriptions, never as a tabular feature
